name: import_premiere_a1_a2_mathematiques_dpfc_2025_2026
query: WITH rows(scope,chapter_title,chapter_order,lesson_title,lesson_order) AS (VALUES ($$A1$$,$$Premier trimestre 2025-2026$$,10,$$Équations et inéquations$$,10),($$A1$$,$$Premier trimestre 2025-2026$$,10,$$Dénombrement$$,20),($$A1$$,$$Premier trimestre 2025-2026$$,10,$$Généralités sur les fonctions$$,30),($$A1$$,$$Deuxième trimestre 2025-2026$$,20,$$Dérivabilité et étude de fonctions$$,10),($$A1$$,$$Deuxième trimestre 2025-2026$$,20,$$Suites numériques$$,20),($$A1$$,$$Troisième trimestre 2025-2026$$,30,$$Statistique$$,10),($$A1$$,$$Troisième trimestre 2025-2026$$,30,$$Systèmes d’équations linéaires dans R × R$$,20),($$A2$$,$$Premier trimestre 2025-2026$$,10,$$Équations et inéquations dans R$$,10),($$A2$$,$$Premier trimestre 2025-2026$$,10,$$Dénombrement$$,20),($$A2$$,$$Premier trimestre 2025-2026$$,10,$$Généralités sur les fonctions$$,30),($$A2$$,$$Deuxième trimestre 2025-2026$$,20,$$Dérivabilité et étude de fonctions$$,10),($$A2$$,$$Deuxième trimestre 2025-2026$$,20,$$Suites numériques$$,20),($$A2$$,$$Troisième trimestre 2025-2026$$,30,$$Statistique$$,10),($$A2$$,$$Troisième trimestre 2025-2026$$,30,$$Systèmes d’équations linéaires dans R × R$$,20)), normalized AS (SELECT o.id AS offering_id,r.chapter_title,r.chapter_order,r.lesson_title,r.lesson_order FROM rows r JOIN levels l ON l.name=$$Première$$ JOIN series se ON se.name=r.scope JOIN subjects su ON su.name=$$Mathématiques$$ JOIN course_subject_offerings o ON o.level_id=l.id AND o.series_id=se.id AND o.subject_id=su.id), chapter_specs AS (SELECT DISTINCT offering_id,chapter_title,chapter_order FROM normalized), inserted_chapters AS (INSERT INTO chapters(subject_offering_id,subject_id,level_id,series_id,title,description,display_order,is_active,is_test_data) SELECT cs.offering_id,o.subject_id,o.level_id,o.series_id,cs.chapter_title,NULL,cs.chapter_order,false,false FROM chapter_specs cs JOIN course_subject_offerings o ON o.id=cs.offering_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapters c WHERE c.subject_offering_id=cs.offering_id AND c.title=cs.chapter_title) RETURNING id,subject_offering_id,title), chapter_targets AS (SELECT c.id,c.subject_offering_id,c.title FROM chapters c JOIN chapter_specs cs ON cs.offering_id=c.subject_offering_id AND cs.chapter_title=c.title UNION ALL SELECT id,subject_offering_id,title FROM inserted_chapters), inserted_lessons AS (INSERT INTO lessons(chapter_id,title,content,description,display_order,is_active,is_test_data) SELECT ct.id,n.lesson_title,NULL,NULL,n.lesson_order,false,false FROM normalized n JOIN chapter_targets ct ON ct.subject_offering_id=n.offering_id AND ct.title=n.chapter_title WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lessons le WHERE le.chapter_id=ct.id AND le.title=n.lesson_title) RETURNING id) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inserted_chapters) AS chapters_inserted,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inserted_lessons) AS lessons_inserted;
